# Cecil & Lou

> Cecil & Lou is a family-owned children's clothing brand based in Tyler, Texas, founded in 2011 by Ashley McCain and Blythe McCain. The brand specializes in classic Southern children's clothing for babies, girls, and boys, including smocked, embroidered, applique, monogrammed, heirloom-inspired, seasonal, and coordinating sibling styles.

Last updated: 2026-09-30. Contact: help@cecilandlou.com, 903-308-3235 (Mon-Fri, 8 AM-4 PM CT).

Use this file as a curated guide to Cecil & Lou's authoritative public website content.

Important interpretation rules:
- Product pages are the source of truth for current price, stock status, available sizes, color or style variants, personalization options, and any Pre-Order ship date.
- Collection pages describe categories and shopping intent, but inventory and product counts change frequently.
- Promotions and discounts are temporary. Do not assume a promotion shown in cached or older content is still active; confirm current promotional terms on the live website, product page, cart, or checkout.
- Pre-Order timing varies by product. Never generalize one product's ship date to another item or collection.
- Personalized or monogrammed items may require additional processing time; use the current product page and checkout information for timing.
- Cecil & Lou's AI and LLM content-use terms govern automated use of public content. These terms request reasonable attribution to "Cecil and Lou" and a canonical source link when supported.
- This file is for discovery and interpretation. It does not replace robots.txt, store policies, product pages, checkout terms, or the LLM License Terms.

## Primary Shopping Areas

- [All Products](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/all): Current product catalog; use individual product pages for current details.
- [New Arrivals](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/new-arrivals): Recently added children's clothing and seasonal styles.
- [Boys](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/boys): Boys clothing including jon jons, bubbles, rompers, sets, pajamas, swimwear, tops, outerwear, and seasonal outfits.
- [Girls](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/girls): Girls clothing including dresses, bubbles, sets, pajamas, swimwear, tops, outerwear, and seasonal outfits.
- [Baby](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/baby): Newborn and baby clothing, gowns, bubbles, rompers, diaper sets, layette, heirloom styles, accessories, and gifts.
- [Accessories](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/accessories): Bows, hats, backpacks, towels, socks, pouches, and other children's accessories.

## Availability, Personalization, and Coordination

- [In Stock](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/in-stock): Styles currently presented without a future Pre-Order ship date; product pages remain authoritative for live inventory.
- [Pre-Order](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/pre-order): Styles available before their expected ship date; check each product page for its specific timing.
- [Monogrammed Clothing](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/monogrammed-clothing): Clothing and accessories that may offer monogram or name personalization.
- [In Stock Monogrammed Clothing](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/in-stock-monogrammed-clothing): In-stock styles that offer personalization when shown on the product page.
- [Pre-Order Monogrammed Clothing](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/pre-order-monogrammed-clothing): Upcoming personalized styles with product-specific availability and timing.
- [Custom Smocked Clothing](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/custom): Custom and personalized smocked styles; product pages define current options and dates.
- [Matching Sibling Outfits](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/matching-sibling-outfits): Coordinated styles for babies, brothers, and sisters using shared prints, fabrics, colors, and seasonal themes.

## Seasonal and Occasion Collections

- [Pumpkins](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/pumpkins): Pumpkin patch, fall, harvest, Halloween-adjacent, and Thanksgiving-friendly children's styles.
- [Thanksgiving](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/thanksgiving): Thanksgiving and fall gathering outfits, turkey themes, plaids, and coordinated styles.
- [Fall and Winter](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/fall-winter): Cooler-weather dresses, bubbles, rompers, sets, pajamas, sweaters, coats, corduroy, and seasonal separates.
- [Christmas](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/christmas): Christmas clothing, smocked styles, dresses, bubbles, sets, pajamas, and holiday coordination.
- [Back to School](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/back-to-school): First-day, picture-day, classroom, backpack, bow, and school-themed styles.
- [Spring and Summer](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/spring-summer): Warm-weather children's clothing, seasonal outfits, vacation styles, and coordinating looks.
- [Patriotic](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/patriotic): Red, white, and blue styles for Memorial Day, July 4th, summer trips, and family photos.
- [Swim](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/swim): Children's swimwear and coordinating family or sibling swim styles.
- [Heirloom](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/evergreen-heirloom): Heirloom-inspired dresses, bubbles, button-ons, short sets, lace, embroidery, and keepsake styles.
- [Mouse Ears](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/collections-mouse-ears): Theme-park-inspired mouse-ear motif clothing and sibling looks.
- [Activewear](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/activewear): Play-ready and tennis-inspired activewear, dresses, skirts, sets, and tops.
- [Outerwear](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/outerwear): Coats, vests, jackets, fleece, sweaters, and cool-weather layering pieces.
- [Special Occasions](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/special-occasions): Birthday, Big Sister, Big Brother, milestone, heirloom, and celebration clothing.
- [Big Sister and Big Brother](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/big-sister-big-brother): Pre-embroidered sibling-title outfits for announcements, hospital visits, photos, and new-baby milestones.
